name: 1-methylpsilocin
summary: 1-Methylpsilocin (developmental code name CMY or CMY-16), also known as 1-methyl-4-hydroxy-N,N-dimethyltryptamine (1-Me-4-HO-DMT), is a serotonin receptor agonist and putative psychedelic drug of the tryptamine and 4-hydroxytryptamine families related to psilocin. It is the 1-methyl derivative of psilocin.

pharmacology.text: The affinities (Ki) of 1-methylpsilocin for serotonin receptors have been reported to be 900 nM for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, 38 nM for the serotonin 5-HT2B receptor, and 7.0 nM for the serotonin 5-HT2C receptor (unedited/INI isoform).
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2C receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: According to Alexander Shulgin in his book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved), 1-methylpsilocin is known to have been assessed in clinical studies by Sandoz (code name CMY or CMY-16) but its activity has not been reported. As such, its properties and effects in humans are unknown.

fact.en: A single extra methyl group on the ring nitrogen of psilocin makes it bind the 5-HT2C receptor far more strongly than the 5-HT2A receptor, the receptor most linked to psychedelic effects.
fact.zh: 在裸蓋菇鹼的環氮上多加一個甲基，就讓它與5-HT2C受體的結合遠強於5-HT2A受體，而後者才是與迷幻作用最相關的受體。
fact.zhHans: 在裸盖菇碱的环氮上多加一个甲基，就让它与5-HT2C受体的结合远强于5-HT2A受体，而后者才是与迷幻作用最相关的受体。
